source: knowledge/web/x-design-posts.md (29 design accounts, 1,161 original posts via api.fxtwitter.com; crops measured in X's public embed, knowledge/benchmarks/x-posts/embed-measure.json; X API media limits from docs.x.com; ranking weights from github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm home-mixer/params/param.rs)
about: Post formats the engine can export so a build is 'worthy to be published on X'. Every canvas size is in device pixels (export at 2x). 'feed_tile' is what the X embed renders in its 514 CSS px media column; X centre-crops anything that does not match the tile ratio.

platform.media_per_post: up to 4 photos, or 1 GIF, or 1 video via the API; the web composer also mixes photos and videos (seen: 2-4 video posts by @oguzyagizkara, @flohoeller)
platform.image_api_limit: JPG/PNG/GIF/WEBP, 5 MB (API); X re-encodes most uploads to JPEG (411 of 444 served stills were .jpg)
platform.video_api_limit: post video 0.5 s to 20 min / 8 GB (default), up to 125 min / 16 GB (Premium); H.264 High, 30 or 60 fps max, AAC LC, aspect 1:3 to 3:1; 1080p playback for subscribers who upload 1080p, 720p otherwise
platform.observed_uploads: designers upload far above the API's 1280x1024 recommendation: median media width 2,160 px; Mariana Castilho and Raphael Salaja post 3840x2160 video, rico 5160x3300 stills

measured_feed_tiles.single_landscape: native ratio, full width 514 px (seen up to 3:1 for video)
measured_feed_tiles.single_portrait: native ratio down to about 0.84 (w/h); a 0.79 image rendered at 514x612 with its top cut off
measured_feed_tiles.two_up: two tiles 256x289 each (0.885, i.e. 7:8), 2 px gap
measured_feed_tiles.three_up: left tile 256x289 (7:8) + right column of two 256x144 tiles (16:9)
measured_feed_tiles.four_up: 2x2 grid of 256x144 tiles (16:9 each); whole grid about 514x290
measured_feed_tiles.crop_anchor: centre (uisabor's 4-up of 3:4 full-page shots shows each page's middle band, not its hero)

platform.caption_fold: about 280 characters before 'Show more' (seen on a Premium long post by @marcelkargul)

ranking_weights_2026.notes: weights scale each viewer's predicted probability, not raw counts; each extra post by the same author in one feed is multiplied by a decaying author-diversity factor; out-of-network posts are discounted; bookmarks are not a weighted action

formats.use_for: one component or micro-interaction (card, meter, composer, dropzone, toast)
formats.loop: one full state cycle that ends where it began (idle -> act -> result -> reset)

background.never: gradient blobs, device frames, browser chrome, desktop wallpaper

formats.crop_distance: component at 1.5-2x scale filling 35-55% of the frame width (Flo grammar), or 'tiny on big' 12-20% width dead centre at 4K (Mariana grammar); pick one
formats.cursor: real pointer (Lucide MousePointer2 or system arrow) that travels, presses (scale 0.9) and releases in sync with the component's phases
formats.poster_frame: the finished, most legible state: embeds and link previews do not autoplay
formats.text_in_media: none; the component's own labels only

formats.use_for: two states, light + dark, two components, or two screens side by side
formats.background: same canvas colour on both tiles; the subject centred in each, with >= 8% margin because the tile is shown uncropped only at exactly 7:8

formats.use_for: one hero shot plus two close-up details of the same product
formats.crop_rule: uploading three equal 7:8 images (Flo) wastes the right column: details get centre-cropped to 16:9; size each image to its own tile
caption_templates: {Product} design that users love to use

formats.use_for: a set: four sections of one landing page, four screens of one product, four explorations
formats.crop_rule: X centre-crops every tile to 16:9; tall full-page screenshots show only their middle band in the feed (uisabor). Crop each image yourself to the 16:9 moment you want seen; keep the full page for the click-through only if the centre band is strong
formats.background: one shared canvas tone across all four so the grid reads as a set
caption_templates: A few {things} I've been working on lately.
Product pages from the past work

formats.use_for: a single-row control: tabs, filters, an input, a nav bar, an underline
formats.background: solid white or #111; the control at 1:1 or 1.5x, centred, no other UI

formats.use_for: proving a fix: a skill, a type tweak, an animation timing change
formats.structure: same frame, same content; a small 'Before / After' chip toggles; hold each state equally long (>= 3 s); the after state is last
caption_templates: A couple of before / after examples of {X}.
Made a small {X} improvement at {Company}: {what changed}

formats.use_for: a technique or principle with code or a side-by-side
formats.feed_tile: 514x514 (the tallest landscape-safe tile: 1.78x the height of a 16:9 post)
caption_templates: Don't forget to {principle}. Here's the difference it makes:

formats.use_for: a landing page or hero section, with its load-in or scroll
formats.background: the site itself edge to edge, or the site on a soft neutral margin (Basit); no browser chrome or a minimal one
caption_templates: Designed it. Built it. Shipped it.
A fresh landing page we recently took from concept to launch.
Spent a little extra time getting {detail} to line up with {Y}. Worth it.

formats.use_for: an icon, a logo, an app tile, a brand mark
formats.background: soft brand-tinted gradient or white; object at 25-35% of frame height, centred, with its own shadow

formats.use_for: an opinion backed by numbers (type scale, tracking, palette, spacing)
formats.feed_tile: 514x612 (portrait 0.84: the largest single footprint in the feed)
formats.crop_rule: keep the portrait ratio >= 0.84 or put nothing important in the top/bottom 6%
formats.text_in_media: yes: the specimen and its values are the content
caption_templates: {Opinion}. This is what I use with {tool}: {value list}

caption_rules.case: sentence case by default (75% of posts); lowercase is a personal voice (Marcel 81%, rauno 67%, lochie 86%), not a default
caption_rules.emoji: at most one, at the end (17% of posts use any)
caption_rules.links: not in a showcase post; put the link, credits and process in the first self-reply (54% of 218 self-replies carry a link)
caption_rules.questions: avoid as the hook: question captions ran at 0.5x the author's median likes (n=17)
caption_rules.fold: the hook and the claim inside the first ~280 characters
